name: grimmsnarl_ml_v12
policy: v9 current-top-four consensus ranker with whole-turn arithmetic search under an explicit overage budget.

arithmetic_search.coverage: every MAIN decision the overage budget allows
arithmetic_search.acceptance: strict arithmetic improvement in all three hidden-state determinizations
arithmetic_search.new_invariant: exposed_prizes - a candidate may not increase the prizes the opponent collects on their immediate reply unless it attacks or deals more damage
arithmetic_search.fallback: v9 on tie, disagreement, incomplete branch, engine error, exhausted budget, or critical regression

description: v12 spends the 96.6% of the per-episode compute budget v11 left unused on covering the whole turn instead of its first decision, and tightens the acceptance gate in step.
